facts.fact: The official gazette compilation lists Ley Núm. 2/2.017, of 10 January 2017, on Firma y Documentos Electrónicos (electronic signature and documents), a law of Equatorial Guinea; the passages held give its title and date, not its text, and the compilation is published 2017-01-10.
